issues.problem: Misuse 1 (using it while having done no study) is not clearly wrong: dictionaries define it as 'luck cannot be forced, so wait calmly', with no requirement to have done one's part, and natives say it jokingly that way; the 'well-known misreading' claim was unfounded.
issues.action: Replaced with a clearly wrong misuse: citing it as a reason to hurry and seize a chance now.

issues.problem: Context 5 and the how line presented 藪から棒で恐縮ですが as a set opener; the attested pattern is 藪から棒な話/お願いで恐縮ですが.
issues.action: Changed context to 藪から棒なお願いで恐縮ですが and rewrote the how line accordingly.

issues.idiom: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
issues.problem: Context 3 (try going to all sorts of events, something will turn up) fits 下手な鉄砲も数撃ちゃ当たる (kw079) just as well, and repeated context 4's 'go out and meet people' idea.
issues.action: Rewrote as a dialogue about stumbling on a famous ramen shop after getting lost: a chance find while out wandering.

issues.idiom: 犬も歩けば棒に当たる
